review_scope: AI technical review (Claude Opus 5.5 with per-locale reviewer agents); no native-speaker signoff.

records.key: How cells and nuclei are found in the slide image: the segmenter, which stain it reads, the Cellpose model and diameter, how far a nucleus is grown to make its cell, and whether the graphics card is used.
records.source: How cells and nuclei are found in the slide image: the segmenter, which stain it reads, the Cellpose model and diameter, how far a nucleus is grown to make its cell, and whether the graphics card is used.
records.translation: Cómo se encuentran las células y los núcleos en la imagen de la preparación: el segmentador, qué tinción lee, el modelo y el diámetro de Cellpose, cuánto se expande un núcleo para formar su célula y si se usa la tarjeta gráfica.

records.key: How much of the slide image is segmented and in what pieces: the pyramid level, an optional window, and the tile size and overlap the image is cut into so a whole slide fits in memory.
records.source: How much of the slide image is segmented and in what pieces: the pyramid level, an optional window, and the tile size and overlap the image is cut into so a whole slide fits in memory.
records.translation: Qué parte de la imagen de la preparación se segmenta y en qué fragmentos: el nivel de la pirámide, una ventana opcional, y el tamaño de tesela y el solapamiento en que se corta la imagen para que una preparación completa quepa en memoria.

records.key: How transcripts or bins are counted into the segmented objects: the Visium HD bin size, the minimum Xenium quality value, which objects receive counts, the gene drawn on the overlay, and whether an AnnData file is written.
records.source: How transcripts or bins are counted into the segmented objects: the Visium HD bin size, the minimum Xenium quality value, which objects receive counts, the gene drawn on the overlay, and whether an AnnData file is written.
records.translation: Cómo se cuentan los transcritos o bins en los objetos segmentados: el tamaño de bin de Visium HD, el valor de calidad mínimo de Xenium, qué objetos reciben recuentos, el gen dibujado en la superposición y si se escribe un archivo AnnData.

records.key: Which genes belong to the pathogen and how many of their transcripts make an object infected. Every object's distance to the nearest infected one is measured from this call.
records.source: Which genes belong to the pathogen and how many of their transcripts make an object infected. Every object's distance to the nearest infected one is measured from this call.
records.translation: Qué genes pertenecen al patógeno y cuántos de sus transcritos hacen que un objeto esté infectado. La distancia de cada objeto al infectado más cercano se mide a partir de esta clasificación.

records.key: Which spatial transcriptomics run is read and where its results go: the Xenium or Visium HD output folder, the platform that wrote it, and either the folder the segmented fields are written to or the masks folder the barcodes are mapped onto. Set these first; every other spatial group assumes they are right.
records.source: Which spatial transcriptomics run is read and where its results go: the Xenium or Visium HD output folder, the platform that wrote it, and either the folder the segmented fields are written to or the masks folder the barcodes are mapped onto. Set these first; every other spatial group assumes they are right.
records.translation: Qué ejecución de transcriptómica espacial se lee y adónde van sus resultados: la carpeta de salida de Xenium o Visium HD, la plataforma que la escribió, y la carpeta en la que se escriben los campos segmentados o la carpeta de máscaras sobre la que se mapean los códigos de barras. Establézcalos primero; todos los demás grupos espaciales suponen que son correctos.

records.key: 3D anchors
records.source: 3D anchors
records.translation: Anclas 3D

records.key: 3D images (*.tif *.tiff *.mrc *.rec *.map)
records.source: 3D images (*.tif *.tiff *.mrc *.rec *.map)
records.translation: Imágenes 3D (*.tif *.tiff *.mrc *.rec *.map)

records.key: Assign 3D objects
records.source: Assign 3D objects
records.translation: Asignar objetos 3D

records.key: Brush radius in screen pixels.
records.source: Brush radius in screen pixels.
records.translation: Radio del pincel en píxeles del monitor.

records.key: Brush size
records.source: Brush size
records.translation: Tamaño del pincel

records.key: Choose a positive object ID that the mask can store.
records.source: Choose a positive object ID that the mask can store.
records.translation: Elija un ID de objeto positivo que la máscara pueda almacenar.

records.key: Choose an object drawn on at least two slices to interpolate.
records.source: Choose an object drawn on at least two slices to interpolate.
records.translation: Elija un objeto dibujado en al menos dos cortes para interpolar.

records.key: Choose an object, then draw it on a few slices; Interpolate slices fills the slices between. Drag anchors in the 3D anchors tab.
records.source: Choose an object, then draw it on a few slices; Interpolate slices fills the slices between. Drag anchors in the 3D anchors tab.
records.translation: Elija un objeto y dibújelo en unos pocos cortes; Interpolar cortes rellena los cortes intermedios. Arrastre las anclas en la pestaña Anclas 3D.

records.key: Choose the X, Y or Z axis for a volume section.
records.source: Choose the X, Y or Z axis for a volume section.
records.translation: Elija el eje X, Y o Z para una sección del volumen.

records.key: Download a FIB-SEM volume of a HeLa cell (about 25 MB, EMPIAR-10982, CC0) and open it unsegmented in the 3D mask editor. Cached after the first download.
records.source: Download a FIB-SEM volume of a HeLa cell (about 25 MB, EMPIAR-10982, CC0) and open it unsegmented in the 3D mask editor. Cached after the first download.
records.translation: Descarga un volumen FIB-SEM de una célula HeLa (unos 25 MB, EMPIAR-10982, CC0) y lo abre sin segmentar en el editor de máscaras 3D. Se guarda en caché tras la primera descarga.

records.key: Downloading the Make Masks FIB-SEM test data
records.source: Downloading the Make Masks FIB-SEM test data
records.translation: Descargando los datos de prueba FIB-SEM de Make Masks

records.key: Draw on XY sections, or on the XZ and YZ side views through the volume.
records.source: Draw on XY sections, or on the XZ and YZ side views through the volume.
records.translation: Dibuje en cortes XY o en las vistas laterales XZ e YZ a través del volumen.

records.key: Draw slices
records.source: Draw slices
records.translation: Dibujar cortes

records.key: Erase every object under the brush on this section.
records.source: Erase every object under the brush on this section.
records.translation: Borra todos los objetos bajo el pincel en este corte.

records.key: FIB-SEM volume with masks, 3D (test data)
records.source: FIB-SEM volume with masks, 3D (test data)
records.translation: Volumen FIB-SEM con máscaras, 3D (datos de prueba)

records.key: FIB-SEM volume, 3D (test data)
records.source: FIB-SEM volume, 3D (test data)
records.translation: Volumen FIB-SEM, 3D (datos de prueba)

records.key: Fill the empty sections between sections where the chosen object is drawn, blending its outline from one to the next.
records.source: Fill the empty sections between sections where the chosen object is drawn, blending its outline from one to the next.
records.translation: Rellena los cortes vacíos entre los cortes donde está dibujado el objeto elegido, fundiendo su contorno de uno al siguiente.

records.key: Give every separate 3D object its own ID: parts of one ID that do not touch in 3D become new objects.
records.source: Give every separate 3D object its own ID: parts of one ID that do not touch in 3D become new objects.
records.translation: Da a cada objeto 3D separado su propio ID: las partes de un ID que no se tocan en 3D pasan a ser objetos nuevos.

records.key: How transcripts or bins are counted into the segmented objects: the Visium HD bin size, the minimum Xenium quality value, which objects receive counts, the gene drawn on the overlay, and whether an AnnData file is written.
records.source: How transcripts or bins are counted into the segmented objects: the Visium HD bin size, the minimum Xenium quality value, which objects receive counts, the gene drawn on the overlay, and whether an AnnData file is written.
records.translation: Cómo se cuentan los transcritos o bins en los objetos segmentados: el tamaño de bin de Visium HD, el valor de calidad mínimo de Xenium, qué objetos reciben recuentos, el gen dibujado en la superposición y si se escribe un archivo AnnData.

records.key: Interpolate slices
records.source: Interpolate slices
records.translation: Interpolar cortes

records.key: Interpolated {n} voxels between the drawn slices.
records.source: Interpolated {n} voxels between the drawn slices.
records.translation: Se interpolaron {n} vóxeles entre los cortes dibujados.

records.key: MRC volumes need the optional mrcfile package: pip install "spacr[tem]"
records.source: MRC volumes need the optional mrcfile package: pip install "spacr[tem]"
records.translation: Los volúmenes MRC necesitan el paquete opcional mrcfile: pip install "spacr[tem]"

records.key: Open a z-stack or volume (TIFF, OME-TIFF or MRC) and draw 3D masks slice by slice, interpolate between slices and save a 3D label TIFF. The current 2D image and mask stay unchanged.
records.source: Open a z-stack or volume (TIFF, OME-TIFF or MRC) and draw 3D masks slice by slice, interpolate between slices and save a 3D label TIFF. The current 2D image and mask stay unchanged.
records.translation: Abre una pila Z o un volumen (TIFF, OME-TIFF o MRC) y dibuja máscaras 3D corte a corte, interpola entre cortes y guarda un TIFF de etiquetas 3D. La imagen 2D y la máscara actuales no cambian.

records.key: Open the FIB-SEM volume in the 3D mask editor with its mitochondria masks loaded for correction. Corrections are saved in corrected_masks; the published masks stay unchanged.
records.source: Open the FIB-SEM volume in the 3D mask editor with its mitochondria masks loaded for correction. Corrections are saved in corrected_masks; the published masks stay unchanged.
records.translation: Abre el volumen FIB-SEM en el editor de máscaras 3D con sus máscaras de mitocondrias cargadas para corregirlas. Las correcciones se guardan en corrected_masks; las máscaras publicadas no cambian.

records.key: Paint the chosen object on this section. Other objects are never overwritten.
records.source: Paint the chosen object on this section. Other objects are never overwritten.
records.translation: Pinta el objeto elegido en este corte. Nunca se sobrescriben otros objetos.

records.key: Slice
records.source: Slice
records.translation: Corte

records.key: The drawn section does not match the volume section.
records.source: The drawn section does not match the volume section.
records.translation: El corte dibujado no coincide con el corte del volumen.

records.key: The section being drawn. Page Up and Page Down step through the volume.
records.source: The section being drawn. Page Up and Page Down step through the volume.
records.translation: El corte que se está dibujando. Page Up y Page Down recorren el volumen.

records.key: The section index lies outside the volume.
records.source: The section index lies outside the volume.
records.translation: El índice del corte queda fuera del volumen.

records.key: This MRC file holds one section, not a volume; open it as a 2D image.
records.source: This MRC file holds one section, not a volume; open it as a 2D image.
records.translation: Este archivo MRC contiene un solo corte, no un volumen; ábralo como imagen 2D.

records.key: This volume exceeds the native volume memory budget.

records.translation: Este volumen supera el presupuesto de memoria para volúmenes nativos.

records.key: spatial_platform
records.source: Which 10x platform wrote spatial_source: auto, xenium, visium_hd (Visium HD bins) or visium (standard spot-based Visium). auto reads it from the files present; set it only when a folder holds more than one layout. Default auto.
records.translation: Qué plataforma de 10x escribió spatial_source: auto, xenium, visium_hd (bins de Visium HD) o visium (Visium estándar basado en spots). auto la deduce de los archivos presentes; establézcalo solo cuando una carpeta contenga más de un diseño. Predeterminado auto.
